findings.explanation: HOL4's only clause is dest_Refv (Refv v) = v. The definition goes through non_wfrec_defn and Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition (Defn.sml:1182, Prim_rec.sml:259), i.e. new_specification, so only that clause is saved and no ARB equation exists. W8array, Varray and Thunk stay open. The Lean catch-all `_ => ARB` makes dest_Refv (W8array ws) = ARB and dest_Refv (W8array ws) = dest_Refv (Varray vs) provable by computation.
findings.repair:
def dest_Refv [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α :=
  select fun f : store_v α → α => ∀ v, f (Refv v) = v
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps

namespace CmlTS

theorem dest_Refv_arb (ws : List word8) : dest_Refv (W8array ws : store_v Nat) = ARB := by
  first | rfl | simp [dest_Refv]

theorem dest_Refv_open (ws : List word8) (vs : List Nat) :
    dest_Refv (W8array ws : store_v Nat) = dest_Refv (Varray vs : store_v Nat) := by
  first | rfl | simp [dest_Refv]

end CmlTS
findings.hol4_check: ?f:num store_v -> num. (!v. f (Refv v) = v) /\ f (W8array []) <> f (Varray [])

findings.explanation: HOL4 has clauses only for Dlet, Dletrec, Dtype, Dtabbrev and Dexn. As a constructor-pattern definition it is made by Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition (new_specification), so FV_dec_def is all that is saved and FV_dec on Dmod, Dlocal and Denv is open. The Lean catch-all `_ => ARB` proves FV_dec (Dmod m ds) = ARB, and also FV_dec (Dmod m ds) = FV_dec (Denv n) for all m, ds, n.
findings.repair:
def FV_dec : dec → Set (ident modN varN) :=
  select fun f : dec → Set (ident modN varN) =>
    (∀ l p e, f (Dlet l p e) = FV (exp.Mat e [(p, exp.Lit ARB)])) ∧
    (∀ l defs, f (Dletrec l defs) = FV (exp.Letrec defs (exp.Lit ARB))) ∧
    (∀ l tds, f (Dtype l tds) = ∅) ∧
    (∀ l tvs tn t, f (Dtabbrev l tvs tn t) = ∅) ∧
    (∀ l cn ts, f (Dexn l cn ts) = ∅)
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps

namespace CmlTS

theorem FV_dec_arb (m : modN) (ds : List dec) : FV_dec (Dmod m ds) = ARB := by
  first | rfl | simp [FV_dec]

theorem FV_dec_open (m : modN) (ds : List dec) (n : tvarN) :
    FV_dec (Dmod m ds) = FV_dec (Denv n) := by
  first | rfl | simp [FV_dec]

end CmlTS
findings.hol4_check: ?f:dec -> (mlstring,mlstring) id set. (!l p e. f (Dlet l p e) = FV (Mat e [(p,Lit ARB)])) /\ (!l defs. f (Dletrec l defs) = FV (Letrec defs (Lit ARB))) /\ (!l t. f (Dtype l t) = {}) /\ (!l tvs tn t. f (Dtabbrev l tvs tn t) = {}) /\ (!l c ts. f (Dexn l c ts) = {}) /\ f (Dmod (strlit "") []) <> f (Denv (strlit ""))
